description.value: Best Garden Restaurant is a long-established casual Chinese dining room that has been serving South Delta since 1991, offering an extensive Cantonese and Szechuan menu prepared without MSG. It operates as a licensed premises with both dine-in and takeout available, as well as home delivery to Tsawwassen and Ladner. A touring cyclist will find a welcoming, unpretentious neighbourhood restaurant with free Wi-Fi.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: stands (5 spaces) at 78m. Total: 5 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website loaded successfully and confirms the business is open, operating since 1991 in Tsawwassen. The website explicitly states 'Free Wi-Fi', 'Eat in or take out', and lists multiple vegetarian menu items, corroborating OSM tags. There is a notable address discrepancy: OSM records '1234 56 Street' but the website clearly states '1284 56 Street' — the website value is used and the discrepancy flagged.
concerns: Address discrepancy: OSM records '1234 56 Street' but the business website clearly states '1284 56 Street'. The website value (1284) has been used as the authoritative address; OSM record may need correction.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible Chinese restaurant operating since 1991 with confirmed website and phone. Useful stop for touring cyclists seeking a meal with Wi-Fi and takeout options.
